messages:
jamie: noticing a sharp nvme write-latency tail in us-west2; GPU attach backlog at ~14, nodes gnode-uw2-{71,72,73} :grimacing:
ops-bot: [ALERT] region=us-west2 metric=nvme_write_tail_latency current=48ms threshold=30ms affected=3
harper: dmesg shows 'nvme0: I/O CRC error' and 'blk_update_request: I/O error' on gnode-uw2-72. Any recent cleaner or app change?
jamie: cleaner ran big sweep 01:10 UTC across those nodes; also a nightly snapshot job started around same time
elliot: could be compounded wear-bitrot on older drives + metadata churn. Do we have HW telemetry on P/E cycles for those hosts?
rafa: pulling hw-telemetry now. Also suggest immediate soft mitigation: reduce cleaner parallelism and pause snapshot job for 30m
maria: agree. quick safe steps: CLEANER_PARALLEL=2 and SNAPSHOT_ENABLE=false for cohort. I'll roll to 3 nodes as canary
jamie: commands:
```
kubectl -n infra set env daemonset/ephemeral-cleaner CLEANER_PARALLEL=2 --context=us-west2
kubectl -n infra set env daemonset/snapshotter ENABLE=false --context=us-west2
```
ops-bot: [METRIC] us-west2 nvme_write_tail_latency 1m=44ms 5m=46ms 15m=22ms
rafa: hw-telemetry: P/E cycles on gnode-uw2-72 = 1.2M (above cohort median 860k), reallocated sectors slightly elevated
harper: ok that hints at wear. mitigation update: also set cleaner.delete_chunk=128MB and enable yield_to_attach flag
maria: applied: delete_chunk=134217728 and annotation cleaner.yield=attach on the daemonset (rolling to 3 nodes). Canary nodes kept at old config for 20m
elliot: risk window estimate: if tail latency responds, 30-90m to clear backlog; if not, prep for migrating non-critical jobs to eu-west1 (costly) or draining specific nodes for drive replacement
jamie: filing INFRA-9812 "us-west2 partial wear -> attach-backlog" owners: rafa (hw), maria (runbook), harper (scheduler). Adding GPU-minute cost estimate and graphs
ops-bot: [ACTION] Created INFRA-9812 with attached graphs and last 200 dmesg lines
maria: current numbers: 1m nvme tail 28ms, attach backlog 5. Keeping observation window 60m
rafa: plan for tomorrow: run targeted SMART reads on suspect nodes, schedule proactive drive replacements if reallocated sectors trend upward. Also propose default: for cohorts with P/E >1M, lower cleaner_parallel to 3
harper: postmortem items: attach-priority semaphore for cleaners, default conservative delete_chunk, and add canary window for cleaner rollouts
jamie: thanks team. will update ticket with final GPU-minute delta and close thread after observation window :thumbsup:
